captions.detailed: An open steel-frame carillon bell tower featuring a grey lattice steel truss structure anchored on four square concrete blocks. Suspended inside the top tier of the frame are three graduated bronze bells, each mounted to an individual black horizontal yoke. The yokes swing on revolute axles attached to the frame cross-beams, and each bell contains an internal clapper suspended on a secondary revolute joint, allowing realistic swinging and tolling motion.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of an open steel-frame carillon bell tower. The tower should feature a grey lattice truss structure anchored on concrete footings, supporting three graduated bronze bells. Each bell must be hung from a black horizontal yoke with a revolute joint to swing from the cross-beams, and include an internal clapper suspended on its own revolute axle.
captions.factory: The code constructs the tower using a grey frame built from cylindrical struts arranged in a rectangular lattice with diagonal cross-braces, anchored on four square box footings. Three graduated bell assemblies are created, each consisting of a conical bell shape (revolved or lofted profile), a box-shaped black yoke, and an internal clapper made of a cylinder and a sphere. Revolute joints are modeled to connect each yoke to the tower frame, and separate revolute joints connect each clapper inside its respective bell.
